headline: IVANHOE MAKOKO COPPER GROWS 30% — 12MT CONTAINED, WORLD'S LARGEST HIGH-GRADE DRC DISCOVERY
snippet: Ivanhoe Mines expanded its Makoko District Mineral Resource by 30% to 34 Mt Indicated at 2.66% Cu and 612 Mt Inferred at 1.80% Cu — approximately 12 million tonnes of contained copper — after 64,000m of 2026 drilling. The company calls it the world's largest and highest-grade copper discovery of the past decade; a Makoko scoping study is set to begin Q1 2027.

headline: AMERICAN PACIFIC DRILLS 30.8M AT 7.4 G/T AU AT MADISON — MASSIVE SULFIDE OPEN AND THICKENING
snippet: American Pacific Mining (CSE: USGD) returned 30.8m of massive sulfide at 7.4 g/t Au, 9.62 g/t Ag and 0.29% Cu from hole M26C-02 at the Madison Copper-Gold Project in Montana, including 20.1m at 11.15 g/t Au and a 7.92m sub-interval at 25.33 g/t Au. The zone is open and thickening to the southwest; the 15,000m 2026 program continues testing deeper porphyry targets.

headline: CANTERRA DRILLS 144M AT 0.75% CuEq AT LUNDBERG — BUCHANS COPPER DISTRICT BACK IN PLAY
snippet: Canterra Minerals' Phase 2 drill program at the Lundberg Deposit in Buchans, Newfoundland returned 144 metres grading 0.75% CuEq, including a higher-grade 76m at 1.00% CuEq — advancing a district-scale copper-zinc growth strategy in one of Canada's historically richest polymetallic camps.

headline: NORD HITS 20,675 G/T SILVER IN 0.3M AT CASTLE EAST — COBALT-SILVER CAMP OPEN ALONG STRIKE
snippet: Nord Precious Metals Mining (CSE: NPM) intersected 20,675 g/t Ag (603 oz/ton) over 0.30m and 10,413 g/t Ag over 0.30m from wedge hole CS-26-140W1 at Castle East, Ontario, within a 2.0m interval averaging 4,683 g/t Ag with 0.53% cobalt. Results fall nine metres from historic holes that anchored the Castle East geological model in the Cobalt-Gowganda silver-cobalt district.

headline: FIRST MAJESTIC HITS 2,604 G/T SILVER AT SAN DIMAS — 89,000M OF 117,000M 2026 PROGRAM DONE
snippet: First Majestic Silver (NYSE: AG) reported high-grade intersections including 2,604 g/t Ag and 43.08 g/t Au over 0.88m true width from the Sinaloa-Elia complex at San Dimas, Mexico. The company has drilled 89,000m of a planned 117,000m 2026 program; new targets at Convención and El Cristo are expanding the district footprint for future resource growth.

headline: GLOBEX DRILLS 24.1M AT 2.6 G/T AU AT DUQUESNE WEST — SHALLOW ABITIBI GOLD CONFIRMED
snippet: Globex Mining Enterprises (TSX-V: GMX) released multiple high-grade shallow gold intersections from Duquesne West in Abitibi, Quebec: hole DQ26-52 returned 24.1m at 2.6 g/t Au and hole DQ26-34 cut 9.5m at 2.7 g/t Au, validating the deposit within one of the world's most productive gold camps.

headline: SUN PEAK HITS 9 FOR 13 AT HALAHILA VMS — 16.5M AT 2.23% ZINC, 25 G/T SILVER IN SAUDI ARABIA
snippet: Sun Peak Metals (CVE: PEAK) reported nine of 13 maiden drill holes at its Halahila VMS Project in Saudi Arabia intersected sulphide mineralization, led by 16.5m at 2.23% Zn, 25 g/t Ag, 0.43 g/t Au and 0.42% Cu. A second VMS target at the nearby Safra Project added 19.42m of 1.17% Cu, 2.59% Zn and 22.35 g/t Ag, pointing to an emerging corridor of VMS mineralization in the Kingdom.

headline: INDIA'S LOHUM SHIPS FIRST ZIMBABWE LITHIUM — 30,000T/YR LCE TARGET WITHIN THREE YEARS
snippet: Indian critical mineral firm Lohum dispatched its first lithium ore shipment from Zimbabwe's Matabeleland South Province, becoming India's first company to produce lithium from overseas mining assets. Its 1,100-hectare position holds an estimated 30-40 Mt of ore worth ~$7 billion at current prices, with plans to build in-country processing and target 30,000 tonnes of lithium carbonate equivalent annually within two to three years.

headline: ANGLO-TECK MEGA-MERGER: EU CLEARS WITH NO CONDITIONS — ONLY CHINA'S ANTI-MONOPOLY NOD REMAINS
snippet: The Anglo American-Teck Resources mega-merger cleared EU antitrust review under a simplified procedure after regulators found no significant competition concerns. Chinese Anti-Monopoly Law approval is the sole outstanding condition; Anglo American expects the deal to close between September 2026 and March 2027, triggering a ~$4.5B special dividend to Anglo shareholders.

headline: SPROTT: WHAT SEPTEMBER'S FED DECISION MEANS FOR GOLD AND SILVER AFTER AUGUST'S DOUBLE-DIGIT SURGE
snippet: Sprott Money's September preview examines what the packed macro calendar — jobs data, back-to-back inflation prints, and the September 15-16 FOMC meeting — means for gold and silver after August's respective 10.5% and 14.9% gains. With gold near $4,400 and silver at $66.50, the analysis argues structural debasement and constrained mine supply remain the dominant bullish forces regardless of the Fed's September decision.
